excerpt.zh: 来自[pops_join_caravan_planet.GetName]的报道指出，有一批居民离开了殖民地，选择加入正穿行于我们领地的[pops_join_caravan_fleet.GetName]舰队，他们表面上说是为了冒险的梦想，不过是被赤裸裸的利益熏昏了头罢了。
excerpt.en: Reports from [pops_join_caravan_planet.GetName] inform us that a number of inhabitants have left the colony to join the [pops_join_caravan_fleet.GetName] fleet passing through our territory, ostensibly drawn by dreams of adventure or the heady aroma of raw mer

texts.zh: 来自[pops_join_caravan_planet.GetName]的报道指出，有一批居民离开了殖民地，选择加入正穿行于我们领地的[pops_join_caravan_fleet.GetName]舰队，他们表面上说是为了冒险的梦想，不过是被赤裸裸的利益熏昏了头罢了。
texts.en: Reports from [pops_join_caravan_planet.GetName] inform us that a number of inhabitants have left the colony to join the [pops_join_caravan_fleet.GetName] fleet passing through our territory, ostensibly drawn by dreams of adventure or the heady aroma of raw mercantilism.

texts.zh: [caravan_pops_join_planet.GetName]传来一条紧急消息，上面说有一批[caravan_pops_join_country.GetName]的原成员目前正打算在这颗星球上寻求政治庇护。当地管理部门决定上报这一情况，让更高阶的官员定夺。
texts.en: An urgent missive from [caravan_pops_join_planet.GetName] explains that a number of now-former members of the [caravan_pops_join_country.GetName] seek political asylum on the planet. The local administration has seen fit to pass the decision of what to do with them up the chain of command.

texts.zh: 我们驻扎在[caravan_hulk_system.GetName]星系恒星基地的情报员报告说，[caravan_hulk_country.GetName]已经离去并遗弃了一艘破旧船只，现在位于中央恒星的不稳定轨道。
texts.en: Our starbase in the [caravan_hulk_system.GetName] system reports that the [caravan_hulk_country.GetName] fleet has evacuated and abandoned a decrepit ship, now in unstable orbit around the system's central star.

label.zh: 把它拖到我们的恒星基地进行报废处理。
label.en: Tow it to the starbase for disposal.

texts.zh: 大概因为是民用运输船的缘故，舰上的数据库并未按照报废规程进行完全清除。尽管在船上没有别的有价值的发现，我们的科学家仍设法获取了某种未知外星科技的部分资料。
texts.en: Likely due to the vessel being a civilian transport, the shipboard databases were not fully scrubbed as part of the decommissioning process. So while nothing else of value was found aboard the ship, our data scientists have managed to recover partial references to unknown alien technologies.

texts.zh: 今天在[disgruntled_planet.GetName]爆发了大规模抗议，由于这个星系中[xeno_fleet.GetName]的种种暴行。他们肮脏的存在侵犯到了所有有正义感的[disgruntled_planet.owner.Species.GetNamePlural]。
texts.en: Mass protests erupted on [disgruntled_planet.GetName] today, due to outrage over the [xeno_fleet.GetName] in the system. Their grubby presence offends all right-thinking [disgruntled_planet.owner.Species.GetNamePlural].

texts.zh: 当[welcome_fleet.GetName]按照原计划进入[pleased_planet.GetName]轨道开展简短的参观的时候，一场自发的友好行动演变成了露天市场和派对，[pleased_planet.owner.Species.GetNamePlural]与[welcome_fleet.owner.Species.GetNamePlural]之间建立起了许多羁绊，做成了很多买卖。
texts.en: As the [welcome_fleet.GetName] entered the orbit of [pleased_planet.GetName] for what should have been a brief courtesy visit today, a spontaneous outbreak of goodwill turned into a combination of open-air market and party. Many bonds between [pleased_planet.owner.Species.GetNamePlural] and [welcome_fleet.owner.Species.GetNamePlural] were forged, and much trading took place.

texts.zh: 在[pleased_planet.GetName]与[party_host.GetNamePlural]共同待了几个月之后，有迹象表明他们之间的关系比预想的更加紧密了。他们想要留下来。
texts.en: In the months following the party with the [party_host.GetNamePlural] on [pleased_planet.GetName], evidence is mounting that some of the bonds formed were closer than expected. They have asked to stay.

texts.zh: 近期[stealing_fleet.GetName]参观[stolen_from_planet.GetName]之后，人们发现有一部分资源居然莫名其妙消失了。人们怀疑是被[stealing_fleet.GetName]给顺手牵羊了。
texts.en: After a recent visit of the [stealing_fleet.GetName] to [stolen_from_planet.GetName] it has been noticed that a number of resources are missing from the central reserve. It is suspected that the [stealing_fleet.GetName] somehow made off with them.

texts.zh: 你好。我是一个收藏家，在这向你提供一个千载难逢的机会。我有一个盒子要出售，盒子当中有什么我不会泄露，我也不会给你看。你可以用3000£energy£能量币来买，然后不管里面有什么都归你了，但是一旦出手概不退换。
texts.en: Greetings. I am The Collector and I offer you an opportunity. I have a box for sale, a box obtained through means I will not divulge and with a content I shall not reveal. You may purchase this box for £energy£ 3000 and keep whatever it contains, but I offer no refunds.

label.zh: 你都不让我们知道箱子里面有什么就打算让我们付钱？
label.en: You expect us to pay for this box with no idea of its contents?

texts.zh: 经常光顾绰尔的罗盘使得[cara_border_planet.GetName]的很多人开始沉迷赌博。许多人为了筹钱继续赌下去而走上了犯罪的道路。
texts.en: Frequent visits to Chor's Compass have resulted in many people on [cara_border_planet.GetName] becoming addicted to gambling. Many have turned to crime in order to pay for repeated trips

texts.zh: [caravaneer_neighbor.GetName]来的大量[caravaneer_neighbor_species.GetName]观光客在[cara_border_planet.GetName]上演变成了一个巨大的派对。然而“派对”开着开着却出了问题，现在变成了一场全球暴动。
texts.en: A visit by a large number of [caravaneer_neighbor_species.GetName] from the [caravaneer_neighbor.GetName] has resulted in a massive party on [cara_border_planet.GetName]. Unfortunately, things have gotten out of hand and the "party" now resembles a planet-wide riot.

texts.zh: [caravaneer_neighbor.GetName]最近发布了一种全新的老虎机，这也使得[cara_border_planet.GetName]在游客的帮助下成功迎来了一次经济的突飞猛进。
texts.en: The [caravaneer_neighbor.GetName] recently revealed a new range of slot machines, and the increased traffic has caused an economic boom on [cara_border_planet.GetName] as visitors pass through.

texts.zh: 绰尔的罗盘是一个专门找刺激的地方。由于经常光顾的原因，[cara_border_planet.GetName]的公民们对于周遭事物的冷静已经到了一个前所未有的水平。
texts.en: Chor's Compass is a rowdy place which is not for the faint of heart. Due to frequent visits, the citizens of [cara_border_planet.GetName] have become accustomed to conditions there to an unprecedented level.

title.zh: 巨尸乐队音乐会：百万雄尸！

texts.zh: [cara_border_planet.GetName]在灵能金属乐巨尸乐队的音乐会失控后陷入混乱。破坏面之广使得人们只能一点点拼凑出当时的情况。不过有一件可以确认的事情是，在演出高潮时科尔-阿赞在月球上打出了一个洞，将它给完全摧毁了。
texts.en: [cara_border_planet.GetName] has been left in chaos after a concert by the Psi-Metal phenomenon Megacorpse got out of hand. Reports are scrambled due to the wide-spread devastation, but one thing they all agree on is that at the height of the performance frontbeing Kel-Azaan punched a hole in the moon, destroying it utterly.

texts.zh: [cara_border_planet.GetName]在灵能金属乐巨尸乐队的音乐会失控后陷入混乱。破坏面之广使得人们只能一点点拼凑出当时的情况。不过有一件可以确认的事情是，在演出高潮时科尔-阿赞把他的超级吉他重重地朝地上砸去，这导致了整个区域被完全破坏。
texts.en: [cara_border_planet.GetName] has been left in chaos after a concert by the Psi-Metal phenomenon Megacorpse got out of hand. Reports are scrambled due to the wide-spread devastation, but one thing they all agree on is that at the height of the performance frontbeing Kel-Azaan slammed its hyper-guitar into the stage with such force the entire area was destroyed.

texts.zh:
巨尸乐队是企业中最伟大的灵能金属乐队。传说那些形态迥异的乐队成员——科尔-阿赞，甘荃，人类，勇达尔，和塞可达瑞——互相之间通过虚境进行交流。

这是真的。

仅仅只有少数人知道，虚境是星河之声下辖的一个绝密的超声音乐研究部门的代号。星河之声在多元宇宙中引领着音乐潮流，同时也是声波武器制造商。巨尸乐队成立的初衷是作为灵能突击部队。他们会在棘手的“会场”进行“演奏”，通过将微弱的灵能攻击性抑制术埋藏在那些公然辱骂企业的歌词下进而影响听众，高效地暗中破坏叛乱行动。

最后，音乐对于乐队成员那已经十分强大的灵能的催化效果实在过于强大，以至于不能被管理者们控制。成员们分道扬镳，只剩空壳乐队名——因为星河之声不愿意撕毁一个无比赚钱的合约。如今巨尸乐队走到哪弹到哪，只要他们觉得合适，只要那是金属乐。
texts.en:
MegaCorpse is the greatest psionic-metal band in corporate space. It is said that the disparate bandmates -- Kel-Azaan, Gantren, Human, Yondar, and Scyldari -- made contact through the Shroud.

This is true.

Known only to a select few, the Shroud is the code-name of a top-secret sono-musical skunkworks division of Galactic Sounds, the leading music conglomerate and sonic weapons manufacturer in the multiverse. The MegaCorpse initiative was originally developed as a psionic strike force. They would "play" difficult "venues," effectively subverting rebellious movements with overtly anti-corporate lyrics disguising subtle psionic aggression-dampening measures inflicted on the listener.

Ultimately, the catalytic effects of their music on the band's already-potent psionic powers soon proved too much for managers and executives to control. The band went rogue in all but name - as Galactic Sounds were unwilling to break a fantastically profitable contract - and today MegaCorpse play whatever and wherever they see fit, as long as it is metal.

texts.zh: 当经历过[Root.GetName]上的大破坏之后，我们不禁在想到底谁才是或者说巨尸乐队到底是怎么样的存在？
texts.en: After the incredible destruction on [Root.GetName] we are left wondering: Who or what are MegaCorpse?

texts.zh: 这艘废弃的舰船被路过的行商抛弃，漂流在我们的一颗恒星的轨道上，或许里面仍有一些有价值的东西。
texts.en: Left drifting in orbit around one of our stars by a passing caravan, this decommissioned hulk may still contain something of value.
